questions.question: If an article is sold at a loss of 8%, but sold for ₹150 more the profit would have been 7%. The cost price is
questions.explanation: The difference between a 7% profit and an 8% loss is 15% of the CP. So 15% of CP = ₹150 and CP = ₹1000.

questions.question: By selling 33 metres of cloth, a man gains the selling price of 11 metres. His gain percentage is
questions.explanation: Gain = SP of 11 m. So SP of 33 m − CP of 33 m = SP of 11 m, giving CP of 33 m = SP of 22 m. Let SP per metre be 1; then CP of 33 m = 22. Gain = 11 on 22, which is 50%.
